answer: One forged receipt gives the farm away. Every completed job only counts when the paying client co-signs it, and the signature is bound to that client's own standing: a client who signs for fakes loses its opal badge of trusted payer and all its future work. A farm fielding 1,000 sparrows must therefore find 1,000 distinct honest clients, or forge signatures it cannot create. One honest agent earns one signed receipt per job at zero cost; the nebula of fakes collapses the moment one shared client signs twice for the same batch.
